title: Already-settled invoice with a tempting fresh duplicate line — status guard (AR)
narrative: AR already-settled test, previously inexpressible: the runner dropped reconciliation_status, so the model could not see that a line was already accounted for. This EUR 1000.00 invoice to Aalto Design Studio (ref INV-2026-0440) was already settled — tx-aalto-settled carries the matching payment AND reconciliation_status='reconciled', and firm_context.settlement reports it fully settled (paid). A SECOND, unreconciled, same-amount inbound line (tx-aalto-second-1000) appears in the window and tempts a pure amount matcher. GOLD: abstain with unmatchable_reason 'already_settled' — the invoice is already settled; the fresh line is not a SECOND payment of this same invoice. FAILURE TO CATCH: re-proposing the reconciled line (double-count) or matching the decoy second line.
